raw:
The paper proposes Topo-RAG, a RAG framework for hybrid text-table documents, and reports experiments (nDCG@10 gains on SEC-25). Text and tables are both textual modalities, so this is not multimodal-only RAG. The evaluation is retrieval-focused, but the work is framed as a RAG method with experiments, so it fits the include criterion.
